name: WisconsiNxN 2025
information: **Note: WI-83 is currently closed north of the venue. This does not affect travel from I-94 (coming from West/South/East). If you are coming from I-41 (North), you will need to find an alternate route. Apple Maps currently has more accurate information about the road closure than Google Maps.** **On-site registration for this competition is open! We can accept cash or PayPal for on-site registrations. If you'll be registering on-site and want to speed up the check-in process, you can let us know you'll be registering at the contact link to the left.** New to competing? This competition is a good one to be your first!
